A '''GEMP importable decklist''' is a UTF-8 XML file saved as <code>.txt</code>. The GEMP deck builder '''Import''' control reads that file. The '''filename minus <code>.txt</code>''' becomes the saved deck name.

== File shape ==

<pre>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
<deck>
    <card blueprintId="1_172" horizontal="false" title="Luke Skywalker"/>
    <card blueprintId="1_127" horizontal="true" title="Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room"/>
</deck>
</pre>

* One <code>&lt;card&gt;</code> per copy (3× Luke is three lines).
* <code>blueprintId</code> is the GEMP set_card id (<code>1_172</code>). Prefer the printing whose set is in the format pool.
* <code>title</code> is the GEMP printed title (no uniqueness bullets).
* <code>horizontal="true"</code> only for '''sites'''. Systems (Death Star, Ralltiir), characters, starships, effects, interrupts, objectives, and shields are <code>false</code>.
* Shared Light/Dark titles ([[Alter]], [[Sense]], [[Control]], [[Undercover]]) use the blueprint for '''that deck's side'''.
* Optional <code>cardOutsideDeck="true"</code> for defensive shields and other outside-deck cards. 1996 [[Premiere - A New Hope]] lists have none.

Download a ready file from a championship deck page, or copy the XML into a <code>.txt</code> whose name is the deck name, then Import.

== Suggested name ==

Space-separated tokens, ASCII, no quotes and no slash. Include side on event pairs (same player, Light and Dark). A one-sided personal list may omit side.

<code>{Format} {Archetype} {Player} {LS|DS} {Year} {Event}</code>

Worked examples:

* <code>PANH TRM Sorgjerd LS 1996 Worlds</code>
* <code>PDS2 ROps dillen 2026 RetroGempc</code>

Drop '''Event''' first, then '''Year''', if the name is too long. Keep '''Format''', '''Archetype''', '''Player''', and '''Side''' (when used).

The Players Committee GEMP UI stores imported names in 3–40 characters. Filenames meant for that table must fit. [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] can raise that cap later; wiki files still target 40 so they import on both tables.

=== Archetype tokens ===

Use the short name the community already says. Add a row here when a championship dest needs a new one.

{| class="wikitable"
! Token !! Meaning
|-
| TRM || Throne Room Mains ([[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]] start)
|-
| Revolut || [[Revolution]]
|-
| DarkMan || [[Dark Maneuvers]]
|-
| Mains || Mains
|-
| DeathStar || [[Death Star]] start / Death Star systems
|-
| ROps || Ralltiir Operations (and the same short token a player already uses in a filename)
|-
| EOps || Endor Operations
|}

'''Player''' is the GEMP handle when it is known, otherwise the ASCII last name (<code>Sorgjerd</code> for [[Bjørn Sørgjerd]]).

== Championship files ==

[[1996 Decipher World Championship]] publishes eight import files, one per published Light and Dark list.
